LanguageData.MS_Craft_PresetsHint: Save the core's full production queue, order, groups and settings for use at other cores or in other saves. Work progress, prepared materials and assigned colonists are not saved.
LanguageData.MS_Craft_PresetsEmpty: No local production lists saved yet.
LanguageData.MS_Craft_PresetOverwriteConfirm: A local list named "{0}" already exists. Overwrite it?
LanguageData.MS_Craft_PresetReplaceConfirm: Replace all production orders at this core with "{0}"? Existing orders will be cancelled. Prepared materials will return to storage, with any remainder placed near the core.
LanguageData.MS_Craft_PresetMissing: The following recipes, ideology types or filter items are unavailable in this save. Unavailable recipes and ideology-specific orders will be skipped, and missing filter items ignored. Continue loading the remaining content?
LanguageData.MS_Craft_PresetNoUsableOrders: This list has no usable production orders. The current queue has not changed.
LanguageData.MS_Craft_PresetReturnFailed: Some order materials could not be returned. The production list was not replaced. Please try again later.
LanguageData.MS_Craft_PresetError: Could not read or write the local production list: {0}
LanguageData.MS_Craft_WorkbenchLockedHint: Locked. Click to spend construction materials and unlock this workbench.
LanguageData.MS_Craft_UnlockWorkbenchQuestion: Spend the following materials to unlock {0}? Materials are taken from the current storage network and its connected auto-restocking shelves.
LanguageData.MS_Craft_NoLegalStuff: No valid construction material is available.
LanguageData.MS_Craft_UnlockMissingMaterials: Not enough available materials, or the storage network is unavailable.
LanguageData.MS_Craft_UnlockSharedHint: Once unlocked, this workbench's recipes are available to every storage network in this save.
LanguageData.MS_Craft_UnlockFailed: Unlock failed because the materials or network changed. Check and try again.
LanguageData.MS_Craft_ProductionNotice: Interrupted work can resume. Products default to network storage, with overflow near the core; they can also be set to drop on the floor.
LanguageData.MS_Craft_NetworkDeliveryHint: Choose where products go. When storing in the network, overflow is placed near the core.
LanguageData.MS_Craft_CountScope: Count items on the map and in this network
LanguageData.MS_Craft_BatchInvalid: This iteration cannot continue; delete the order to return remaining ingredients
LanguageData.MS_Craft_OpenDesc: Manage recipes, ingredients and workers for connected cosmic workbenches.
LanguageData.MS_Craft_LoadFailure_Text: {0} production order(s) failed to load. Another mod may have been removed, or a mod update changed its recipes.
LanguageData.MS_Craft_AllowedWorkTypesDesc: Choose which work types this cosmic workbench can perform.
LanguageData.MS_Craft_AllowedWorkTypesHint: Only checked work types are allowed. Uncheck every type to stop this workbench from accepting production jobs.
LanguageData.MS_Craft_PreferredRoomRoleHint: Choose the room purpose of this workbench. This affects room classification and the work speed penalty for an unsuitable room. Other furniture also affects the final room type.
LanguageData.MS_Craft_WorkTypeNotAllowed: This workbench does not allow this work type
LanguageData.MS_Craft_GroupModeOff: Enable grouping mode. Work order is affected by groups.
LanguageData.MS_Craft_GroupModeOn: Disable grouping mode and show the same production priority as a flat list. Existing groups are kept.
LanguageData.MS_Craft_DeleteGroup: Delete this group and move its orders to Ungrouped.
LanguageData.MS_Craft_DragOrder: Hold the left or right mouse button and drag a task to change production priority. Dragging across groups also changes its group.
LanguageData.MS_Craft_DragGroup: Click to expand or collapse. Hold the left or right mouse button and drag the header to change the whole group's production priority.
LanguageData.MS_Craft_FavoriteWorkbench: Favorite this workbench and move it to the top.
LanguageData.MS_Craft_BottomWorkbench: Move this workbench to the bottom and remove it from favorites.
LanguageData.MS_Craft_RestoreWorkbenchOrder: Remove the bottom marker and restore this workbench's normal order.
LanguageData.MS_Craft_CompactModeOff: Enable compact mode for the workbench list.
LanguageData.MS_Craft_CompactModeOn: Disable compact mode for the workbench list.
LanguageData.MS_Craft_RecipeCompactModeOff: Enable compact mode for the recipe list.
LanguageData.MS_Craft_RecipeCompactModeOn: Disable compact mode for the recipe list.
LanguageData.MS_Craft_NoOrders: No production orders yet. Select a workbench on the right to add a recipe.
LanguageData.MS_Craft_NoMatchingWorkbenches: No unlocked workbenches with available recipes match these filters.
LanguageData.MS_Craft_HaulingTabHint: Vanilla crematorium bills are hauling work. Surprising, right?
LanguageData.MS_Craft_ContinuousAddHint: Hold Ctrl to add tasks continuously
LanguageData.MS_Craft_NoOutputBody: This recipe defines no output! It may be a production result that another mod implements in code.\n\nIt may work normally, or it may not produce the expected result. Judge for yourself. If it does not work, use a production output port together with that mod's own workbench.
LanguageData.MS_Craft_Satisfied: No repeats remaining, target met or waiting to resume
LanguageData.MS_Craft_MaterialLastCheck: Results from the last material check.
LanguageData.MS_Craft_MaterialRecheck: Materials are checked every {0} seconds of game time.
LanguageData.MS_Craft_NoWorker: No eligible worker with the work type enabled
LanguageData.MS_Craft_NoOrdersForWorkType: This pawn has no eligible recipes
LanguageData.MS_Craft_SelectedWorkerNotAllowed: This pawn is not assigned to this work type or does not meet the order's skill and worker restrictions
LanguageData.MS_Craft_Duplicate: Duplicate this order, including counts, repeat mode, ingredient filter, product delivery and worker conditions. The copy is placed directly after it.
LanguageData.MS_Craft_WaitingToResume: Waiting for the count to reach the resume threshold
LanguageData.MS_Craft_AlsoCountsHint: Selected items also count toward the "Do until X" target.
LanguageData.MS_Craft_NamedWorkerHint: As in vanilla, a named worker ignores this range. The recipe's minimum skill requirements still apply.
LanguageData.MS_Craft_LimitStuff: Count only products made of allowed ingredients
LanguageData.MS_Craft_WorkbenchFilterOn: Workbench filter: on. Hides orders assigned elsewhere, printer-only orders, and work types disabled at this bench. Click to show all orders.
LanguageData.MS_Craft_WorkbenchFilterOff: Workbench filter: off. Click to hide orders assigned elsewhere, printer-only orders, and work types disabled at this bench.
